entryPoints: track briefs: register for this track → (preselects the track)
registration.mechanism: Any element with [data-register] opens the application panel (components/Registration.tsx); [data-track] preselects the track. Close via Close ×, Save and close, backdrop click, Esc or browser back.
registration.backend: None. On submit the answers are posted (no-cors) to the live Google Form's formResponse endpoint, so every application lands in the Form and its response Sheet. Works on GitHub Pages.
registration.definition: lib/application-form.ts mirrors the live Google Form (entry IDs, titles, help, choices, limits). Do not delete, re-create or add required questions in the Form once applications open.
registration.drafts: Autosaved in localStorage (gsc-application-v3) on every keystroke; resumes on the same device and browser only.
flow: Intro: close date, what to have ready, link to the rubric
Eligibility 1 to 4 (email and mobile first, then one knock-out question per page). A knock-out answer shows 'This edition is not for you' with 'Change my answer'

The founders: up to 4. Founder 1 required (name, role, email, mobile, LinkedIn; X and another link optional). Founders 2 to 4 optional, but a started slot needs name, role, email, mobile and LinkedIn. Founder 1's email and mobile carry over from page 1
The team · The problem and the market · The product
Scalability and unit cost · Materials and declaration (six declarations, all required)
Submit → 'application received' screen; results on a rolling basis
registration.validation: Checked when the founder leaves a field and again on Continue and Submit: CIN (21 characters, valid state code, possible year, private company type) or LLPIN (AAA-1234), matched to the incorporation answer; company name ending in Private Limited or LLP; DPIIT number format; city plus state; email format, typo domains, disposable and placeholder addresses; 10-digit Indian mobiles, placeholders rejected; LinkedIn /in/ profile links, X profile links; YouTube, Vimeo, Loom or Drive video links; deck links that point to a file; whole-rupee revenue; team size; placeholder, repeated or copy-pasted written answers; duplicate email, mobile or LinkedIn across founders; a hidden bot trap.
registration.window: Before 9 October 2026 founders can draft but not submit; after 10 November 2026 11:59 pm IST submissions are closed.
limits: Google does not report success to other sites, so a completed request is treated as delivered.
Answers cannot be edited after submitting.

reviewNotes: npm audit flags Next.js 14.2.35 (critical) and its bundled PostCSS (high). Server-side advisories do not affect the static build but apply once the registration backend is hosted; the fix is a major upgrade to Next.js 16, to be done on its own branch.
No analytics or event tracking is instrumented yet; the ctaInventory above is the suggested event list.
